evidence: Labels 'Windows' and 'Build system'; modifies CMakeLists.txt, CI scripts, and toolchain presets to switch native Windows builds from MSVC to clang-cl.
rationale: Migrating native Windows builds to clang-cl resolves recurring MSVC internal compiler errors and cuts Windows CI build times from 20m 35s to 12m 43s. It also removes compiler workarounds across the codebase and unblocks hardware-accelerated inline assembly on Windows.
